---
applyTo: "**/{app,pages,components,frontend,web,src}/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,css,scss}"
---

# Frontend path instructions

- Build accessible UI by default.
- Include loading, empty, error, success, and permission-denied states.
- Keep server state, local UI state, and presentation separated.
- Prefer shared/generated types for API data.
- Add component tests and e2e tests for critical flows.
- Attach screenshots or visual notes in PRs for visible UI changes.
